question_bank_correct_index_range.name: question_bank_correct_index_range
question_bank_correct_index_range.value: "question_bank"."correct_index" >= 0 and "question_bank"."correct_index" < cardinality("question_bank"."options") and cardinality("question_bank"."options") between 2 and 6

user_sanctions_expiry_idx.name: user_sanctions_expiry_idx
user_sanctions_expiry_idx.where: "user_sanctions"."lifted_at" is null and "user_sanctions"."ends_at" is not null

learning_requests_open_has_expiry.name: learning_requests_open_has_expiry
learning_requests_open_has_expiry.value: "learning_requests"."status" <> 'OPEN' or ("learning_requests"."published_at" is not null and "learning_requests"."expires_at" is not null)
